purpose: Cold-start or refresh one agent from a shared-fresh prompt policy, replayable SCHED frontier, fresh read-only GitHub issue pressure, sibling activity, and independently versioned rehydration continuation state without using prior chat memory as executable state.
authority_ceiling: routing and reconstruction only; below scheduler claim/execution authority, evidence, prompt promotion, merge, release, billing, and user authority

address.git_head: repository causal/provenance coordinate observed after the selected boot-level shared Git freshness membrane
address.prompt_stack_digest: content identity of selected prompt policy/modules/overlays
address.frontier_source_head: exact shared SCHED source commit reduced into the packet
address.frontier_digest: portable reduced scheduler-content identity under the pinned interpretation contract
address.sched_contract_digest: identity of the scheduler interpretation contract used by the reduction
address.issue_pressure_digest: content identity of the bounded relevant read-only GitHub issue-pressure projection
address.sibling_state_digest: content identity of observed claim/event-lag/recent-durable sibling telemetry
address.rehydration_continuation_digest: independent identity of active-loop set, selected continuation loop, handoff digest and hydration mode
address.composite_digest_law: hash the coordinate identities; do not replace or conflate the individual coordinates

shared_freshness.REQUIRED: failed, dirty, ahead, diverged, or otherwise unverified shared Git state yields BOOTSTRAP_HOLD with BOOTSTRAP_SHARED_FRONTIER_HOLD; never return a false shared-current packet
shared_freshness.BEST_EFFORT: attempt shared sync first and preserve explicit unverified standing when a shared witness is unavailable
shared_freshness.DISABLED: allow local/offline reconstruction while making no shared-current claim
shared_freshness.continuation_default: unless explicitly overridden, continuation_shared_remote_mode inherits the boot shared_remote_mode
shared_freshness.refresh_inheritance: live-session refresh remembers and reuses the selected boot shared_remote_mode before recomputing the composite packet
shared_freshness.separation: world-state freshness and continuation freshness remain distinct coordinates even when they consult the same remote

continuation.source: canonical shared-fresh ATHENA.REHYDRATION.LOOP.V1 index plus ATHENA.REHYDRATION.HANDOFF.DELTA.V1
continuation.zero_active_loops: NO_ACTIVE_CONTINUATION is lawful and does not hold generic bootstrap
continuation.routing_successor: transport receipt-bound WHAT-NEXT context from the canonical routing successor without re-scoring it

issue_pressure.stored_body_form: SHA-256 digest, not issue body text
issue_pressure.secret_law: OAuth/PAT/token material comes only from runtime environment and is never emitted or persisted

siblings.law: sibling state is provider/Git observation, never private chain-of-thought

selection.source: only EVENT_REDUCED ready_work already present in the exact returned frontier packet
selection.law: issue pressure may influence routing context but may never manufacture scheduler readiness

refresh.law: shared-sync first, then recompute changed coordinates and affected dependency cones; a handoff-only change must not force prompt/frontier/issue refresh

execution_surface.claim_authority: derive from actually registered frontier tools; never infer from issue prose or continuation state

cold_process_acceptance.process_boundary: actual independent python -m athena_mcp stdio JSON-RPC processes with isolated SQLite DBs and clones
cold_process_acceptance.forbidden_shortcut: no session object, prompt text, handoff packet, or chat-memory state may be copied between agents
required_story: prep MCP publishes first durable rehydration transition and exits
two later cold MCPs independently reconstruct identical shared address and handoff identity
one cold MCP publishes the next verified transition
the sibling observes continuation change only through its own athena_agent_refresh
a third cold MCP independently reconstructs the sibling's refreshed shared address
